description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface to configure AWS DynamoDB as the default or named grain storage in an Orleans silo setup. It provides methods to add DynamoDB storage using options or options builder pattern.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure DynamoDB storage for Orleans grains.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage as the default grain storage, accepting options directly.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage with a specific name, accepting options directly.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage as the default grain storage, accepting an OptionsBuilder for options.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage with a specific name, accepting an OptionsBuilder for options.
